arguments.message: Hi Domonique, I'm Romana. My top skill is testing. I'm most efficient with the ISSUE-0001 tasks (especially triage, review, and docs). Since ISSUE-0002 tasks are critical priority, do you have skills in security or mobile-development to cover those? If so, I'll focus on the ISSUE-0001 tasks to maximize our total completed tasks.

I'll aim for ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 3.04, high priority) or ISSUE-0001::test (cost 2.13, high priority) as they align best with my skills and availability. Let me know if you prefer those!
